For visitors

RASC members ride free; visitors can try it as a guest up to two times after signing the guest waiver. Routes and meet spot post on the RASC calendar and Discord. Daylight is short in October, so bring front and rear lights.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it’s a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever’s leading that you’re new.
Pace
The easiest pace the host lists is 10–12 mph: you can talk the whole way. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at the host’s website the day of — that’s where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Dirty RASCals Thursday Gravel group ride

Dirty RASCals Thursday Gravel is a gravel group ride in Rochester, MN. It rolls every Thursday at 6:00 pm from Varies each week (Oct 1 was Pine Island Trailhead Grille); see the RASC calendar.

RASC’s Thursday-night gravel ride, rolling out at 6:00 pm from a different spot around Rochester each week, often a brewery, grill or trailhead. Riders sort into casual speed groups on arrival. Most weeks end with drinks and food. The RideWithGPS calendar lists a ride every Thursday through Oct 29, 2026.
